Commentary.Commentary: Right then the Kiwis stretch the lead to 4-0 against a toothless Pakistan side. The 5th and final game of the 5-match T20I series will be played on 21st January. The game will be live from 5.30 am IST (12 am GMT) but you can join us an hour early for the build-up. Till then cheers!
Daryl Mitchell is adjudged the player of the match for his brilliant knock of 72 runs.

Earlier in the day, after being put in to bat first the Pakistan innings started on a low again as they lost Saim Ayub in the second over of the game. Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan added 51 off 31 for the 2nd wicket partnership. The batters found it difficult to get boundaries but managed to rotate strikes frequently. The Pakistan innings was in a sorry situation but a late surge from Mohammad Nawaz and Mohammad Rizwan for the 6th wicket partnership adding 32 off the last 17 helped them post a fighting total. Mohammad Rizwan was the best batter for the visitors as he smashed 90 off 60 deliveries. Mohammad Nawaz played a good cameo right at the end with 21 runs off 9 deliveries as well. The Kiwi bowlers were spot one with line and lengths. Lockie Ferguson and Matt Henry picked up a couple while Adam Milne took a wicket as well.

The Pakistani bowlers did start well but lost their way in the middle. The fielder let them down as well with poor fielding efforts. The skipper Shaheen Afridi took 3 in his first spell and that was it for the wickets column of the Pakistani bowlers. The side needs to think about its toothless bowling attack as that's been the reason for their demise in all the games played so far.

Chasing down a decent total, The Kiwi innings started on a low with Shaheen Afridi picking up a couple in the very first over. Finn Allen, Tim Seifert, and Will Young departed in a jiffy as the hosts were 3 down for 20 inside 3 overs. Glenn Phillips and Daryl Mitchell then built up a solid partnership by striking each ball on its merit and they were aided by the Pakistani fielder who were poor in the field. The duo added 139 runs for the third wicket partnership off just 93 deliveries. Daryl Mitchell and Glenn Phillips remained unbeaten with scores of 72 and 70 respectively.

Afer being 20 for 3, the kiwis get over the line yet again, thanks to a brilliant third-wicket partnership between Daryl Mitchell and Glenn Phillips. The hosts have defeated Pakistan by 7 wickets as they go 4-0 up in the 5-match T20I series.

FOUR! MAKE THAT 4 WINS IN THIS SERIES FOR New Zealand! Haris Rauf drops it short and over off. Daryl Mitchell pulls and connects well, and places it in the gap. The ball rockets away to the deep mid-wicket fence for four runs to finish off the game.

Commentary.Commentary: Short now over off. Daryl Mitchell stays in his crease and punches it to the right of the bowler. They run another single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Zaman Khan to Daryl Mitchell, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a very good length over leg. Will Young flicks it away towards square leg and gets off the mark with a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Zaman Khan to Will Young, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Shaheen Afridi has 2 in the first over and it is Daryl Mitchell walking out next in the middle. It will be Zaman Khan to bowl from the other end.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shaheen Afridi gets another in the first over of the innings. He delivers it a bit fuller and on middle. Tim Seifert fails to read the ball and ends up chipping it towards mid off. Babar Azam is the fielder stationed there and he also takes a very simple catch. Tim Seifert departs without doing any damage and Shaheen Afridi has given Pakistan a very strong start.
Commentary.Howout: c Babar Azam b Shaheen Afridi
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Shaheen Afridi to Tim Seifert, OUT! c Babar Azam b Shaheen Afridi.

Commentary.Commentary: On the hard length aimed at the pads. The ball deflects off Will Young's thigh pads and rolls away to short fine leg. The batters take a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Shaheen Afridi to Will Young, Leg bye.

Commentary.Commentary: Errs in line now. Shaheen Afridi bowls it down the leg side. Will Young leaves it alone and the umpire signals a wide.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Shaheen Afridi to Will Young, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Will Young walks out next.

OUT! TAKEN! Shaheen Afridi makes a brilliant comeback after being hit for two boundaries. He delivers it on length and on middle and leg. Finn Allen tries to flick this on on the on side as well but gets the leading edge. The ball flies away towards point where Saim Ayub takes a safe catch. It is a big wicket for Pakistan and Shaheen Afridi is pumped up.
Commentary.Howout: c Saim Ayub b Shaheen Afridi
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Shaheen Afridi to Finn Allen, OUT! c Saim Ayub b Shaheen Afridi.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR AGAIN! This time it was a poor delivery by Shaheen Afridi as he angled it down the leg side. Finn Allen manages to flick it well and sends it past the fielder at short fine leg. The ball runs away to the fine leg fence for four runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Shaheen Afridi to Finn Allen, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Off the mark in style! Shaheen Afridi goes full now and on the stumps. Finn Allen reads the swing well and flicks it well over the fielder at mid-wicket. He has timed the ball well and it races away to the fence for four runs to get the scoreboard going.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Shaheen Afridi to Finn Allen, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Starts off well. Shaheen Afridi bowls it on a good length and the ball swings in hitting the pads of Finn Alle who couldn't play the flick shot.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Shaheen Afridi to Finn Allen, No run.
